channel.title: American Faith – Bias and Credibility - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from American Faith – Bias and Credibility (americanfaith.com)

item.title: Biden Judge Blocks RFK Jr. From Saying Trans Procedures Are Unsafe
item.description: A federal judge appointed under the former Biden administration has blocked the Trump administration from enforcing a Health and Human Services declaration that labeled gender-transition procedures for minors "neither safe nor effective."

item.title: House GOP Probes Billions in California Hospice Fraud
item.description: Republicans on the House Committee on Oversight and Government Reform launched a formal investigation into what they're calling "rampant taxpayer fraud" in California's hospice industry, demanding records from Gov. Gavin Newsom (D) and raising questions about billions in Medicare losses.

item.title: Senator Claims Trump 'Lying' About Iranian Talks
item.description: Senator Chris Van Hollen (D-MD) told CNN's Kasie Hunt on "The Arena" that President Trump is "lying" about holding discussions with Iran.

item.title: Costa Rica Agrees to Take Deportees
item.description: Costa Rica has signed an initial agreement with the United States to accept deportees from other countries.

item.title: Pentagon Changes Press Policy After Court Pressure
item.description: The Pentagon has updated its media policy after a court issued an order demanding that the Trump administration's press access policy be changed, arguing that it was unconstitutional.

item.title: California School District Sold Diplomas to Chinese Students
item.description: A California public school district allegedly issued fraudulent high school diplomas to students living in China through a secret "sister school" partnership, a sweeping new audit has found.

item.title: Grassley Exposes Scope of Jack Smith Subpoena Effort
item.description: Former Special Counsel Jack Smith went after more than two years' worth of records for now-FBI Director Kash Patel as part of his investigation into President Trump, Senator Chuck Grassley (R-IA) revealed.

item.title: New Presidential Envoy Revealed - American Faith
item.description: Nick Adams will serve as the special presidential envoy for "American tourism, exceptionalism, and values."

item.title: Pentagon Awards Purple Hearts Those Who Killed ISIS Attacker
item.description: Army Secretary Dan Driscoll and Sgt. Maj. of the Army Michael Weimer personally awarded eight Meritorious Service Medals and two Purple Hearts to Old Dominion University ROTC cadets this week for stopping the March 12 terrorist attack on the Norfolk, Virginia campus.

item.title: California Sues Trump Admin to Block Oil Comeback
item.description: The state of California has filed a lawsuit against the Trump administration over an order demanding that Sable Offshore Corporation restart its oil pipelines in the state.
